info.name: Owned read-only SQL canary row disclosure
author: fuzzy-technologies
info.description: The explicitly selected endpoint returned only the owned lab's non-secret private row. This response check is not a general SQL injection detector; separately approved baseline, true, false and parameterized controls establish the real SQLite mechanism in the finite acceptance scenario.
